name: Café
description: A warm small-business theme for NimbusCMS — a menu or catalogue, an about page, a landing hero. Plain PHP templates, one stylesheet, no build step. Extracted from the Nimbus demo (Fern & Kettle). An official theme.

templates.layout: HTML shell; includes header and footer.
templates.header: Site header with the wordmark and the main menu.
templates.footer: Footer with hours, links, and contact.
templates.entry-home: The landing page (the `home` singleton) — hero + featured items.
templates.entry: A single page (an about / info `pages` entry).
templates.collection-menu: The menu (a `menu` collection), grouped by section with prices.
templates.markdown: Renders a Markdown field (pairs with the Markdown plugin).

specialization: entry-home renders the `home` singleton; collection-menu renders a `menu` collection (items with a section, price and optional featured flag). Rename the collection templates to fit any small-business catalogue (a shop, a services list).
assets: Files under assets/ are served at /theme/assets/<path> (e.g. assets/app.css -> /theme/assets/app.css). Allowlisted types only; no PHP.
